title: Conversation memory: running summary, follow-up rewriting and recall
description: Keep recent turns verbatim, fold older turns into a persisted, versioned, incrementally updated summary built by a background job, rewrite follow-up questions into standalone search queries, and recall relevant earlier turns by embedding. Local chats compact with their local model; hosted chats with Luna. Original messages are never altered.
acceptance_criteria: Given a 40-turn conversation, when asking about a fact from turn 2, then the answer uses the summary or recalled turn and stays within budget.
Given a completed turn over the threshold, when compaction runs twice for the same range, then exactly one summary version is produced.
Given a local chat, when compaction runs, then no hosted model is called.
Given a follow-up such as 'how did it compare to the baselines?', when retrieving, then the persisted standalone query names the subject and the retrieved evidence matches it.
Given the planner fails, when a question is asked, then the deterministic fallback query is used and the answer still completes.
test_cases: Compaction job idempotency on real Postgres; planner structured-output fixtures; recall retrieval tests; long-conversation fixture.
verification:
Agent G (feat/rag-memory) built the structured query planner, versioned running summaries (compact_chat) and turn recall, TDD per task.
Tests: test_query_planner.py (17 tests, including first turn without a call, fallback, local planning without hosted calls, and the summary head surviving long answers); test_compaction_integration.py (idempotent ranges, stale jobs skip without a call, local chats never use a hosted model).
Live: a 20-turn Luna chat built summary versions 1-3 and recalled 2-3 turns per answer. The final question lost the user's goal because the planner kept only the newest 1,500 tokens; c869233 gives the summary head its own share and keeps every recent question (red: the prompt held only long-answer text). The replay cited pages 4 and 18-19. A local IFM 7B chat compacted with the 7B itself (summary v1, 6 of 8 messages).
Final: backend 760 passed with Ruff clean. Live (ara-rag-live, real OpenAI key, Attention and RAG papers): see the journal entry 'Wave 3 merge, Wave 4 integration and live verification'.
Review and live checks: idle-time local compaction (3f04f5b); bounded wait for background local work (691dd9c); stored memory_model setting (e37dca9); heading-only summaries fail (4cad3d6); cut local summaries keep whole lines (f13027b); failed ranges retry at most three times and a cut summary that adds nothing fails COMPACTION_TRUNCATED (671bb9d). Live: deferral and waiting worked on IFM 7B; better local summaries are tracked in ARA-081. Whole-branch review fixes on 2026-10-09 (journal: 'Whole-branch review and fixes'). Final: backend 802 passed with Ruff clean; frontend check 454 and build pass.
